problem_statement: Let G1 and G2 be the two explicit Legendrian fronts of smooth type 6_3 with tb=-1 and r=0 in the research record, each admitting at least two graded Z/2 augmentations with identical linearized contact homology Poincaré polynomials. Determine whether some ordered augmentation pair yields bilinearized Legendrian contact homology of different rank on G1 versus G2, separating the fronts beyond linearized data.
